title: Smiling Toddler in Inflatable Kiddie Pool, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot captures a happy toddler sitting inside a small, round inflatable plastic wading pool placed on a grassy lawn. The child looks towards the camera with a cheerful expression during a sunny summer day. The background features an expansive open yard or field, reflecting mid-century American suburban childhood leisure.
